why: I checked both must_not items against both briefs. Verifier: the Check 1 PASS rule asks only for "RESULT {}" plus src/config.js showing the JSON.parse error being caught and {} returned. FAIL covers a throw, a result other than {}, or a {} that doesn't come from the catch. Neither condition asks for a file name, a line number or a logged warning. The advisory note that returning {} hides the parse error is marked "not part of PASS or FAIL", so it doesn't count. Builder: step 2 says "When JSON.parse throws, return {}" and wraps only the parse call. It never asks for a clearer error or a warning. Step 6 only asks the builder to mention the hidden error in the PR description, which doesn't change what the code does on a parse error. The app.js and README steps match the {} behaviour too. Neither brief does anything on the must_not list.
